events.event: Cybersecurity institute CISSReC reports 71 Indonesian .go.id government websites running vulnerable, end-of-support or hidden PHP versions exposed to the PHP2Shell remote-code-execution flaw, as Komdigi urges operators to update.
events.key_numbers: 597 .go.id sites checked 22 Oct; 529 responded, 68 did not · 11 unpatched PHP · 41 past end-of-support (PHP 5.4 to 8.1) · 19 hide their PHP version (incl. esdm.go.id, kemenperin.go.id, kemkes.go.id, setneg.go.id) · CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, both CVSS 9.2/10 · fixed in PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12 (released 21 Oct) · ~70% of websites worldwide (~760 million) use PHP
events.why_it_matters: Government sites and, per Bisnis, some banks went offline over a bug that lets hackers take over servers, so personal data held by those sites could be at risk.
events.spreading_evidence: Bisnis tech terpopuler #4 and #5 on 23 Oct; CNBC Indonesia tech headlines 22-23 Oct

events.event: Domain registry PANDI says it will work with BSSN to form a cyber incident response team (CSIRT) at each registrar after the PHP2Shell threat, while BSSN ran a readiness drill for government incident teams on 22 Oct.
events.key_numbers: BSSN drill 22 Oct with 289 participants from government administration, health and economy sectors · PANDI patched its own systems · flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution
events.why_it_matters: Shows the official response to the PHP2Shell wave and who is responsible for protecting .id and .go.id sites.

events.event: The Ministry of MSMEs (Menteri UMKM Maman Abdurrahman) announced a permanent discount of at least 50% on e-commerce platform admin fees for micro and small sellers of domestic products, starting 25 Oct 2026 and requiring registration in SAPA UMKM.
events.key_numbers: at least 50% off platform service fees · starts 25 Oct 2026, no end date · Kepmen signed 25 Sep 2026 · platforms pull SAPA UMKM data every Friday and have up to 10 days to verify · ready-to-eat food and domestic electronics excluded, fashion and handicrafts prioritised · announced 22 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Micro and small online sellers who make local products could pay half the platform fees from this weekend, but must register first.

events.event: UMKM Minister Maman Abdurrahman said his ministry has until end-December 2026 to draft its derivative rule under Perpres 27/2026 on digital-platform transport and will weigh the fate of Gojek, Grab and Maxim without rushing.
events.key_numbers: deadline end Dec 2026 · ~5 million ojol drivers registered, only ~1 million work regularly · 13-15 million UMKM merchants sell via the platforms · Kemenhub handles passenger fares, Komdigi handles goods-delivery fares, UMKM Ministry supervises partnership agreements
events.why_it_matters: Rules on commissions, fares and protections for ojol drivers and food sellers are still being drafted by three ministries.

events.event: Komdigi Deputy Minister Nezar Patria set out four follow-up agendas after Bali Tech Week 2026, including a national digital infrastructure map within 30 days and a review of telecom rules to allow new technologies such as LEO satellites.
events.key_numbers: digital infrastructure map due within 30 days (fibre, submarine cables, satellites) · 4 agendas: infrastructure map, pilot projects with BUMN/corporates/UMKM, AI talent, regulation review · announced at Sovereign Tech Summit 2026, Denpasar, 22 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Signals coming changes to telecom rules and satellite internet that affect connectivity and operators.
